get.description: Current guard owner only. No query keys. Missing row returns false; creates no card or participation.

200.description: Current committed choice; raw business object, Cache-Control no-store.

put.description: No query keys; exactly one required boolean enrolled. Identity/type/location/radius keys are rejected. true requires an existing valid own card type (private card allowed); false is always allowed without a card/type/location. Same owner transaction lock as F5, one unique owner FK row, same-value retries stable. Returns after commit. Does not change discoverable, visibility, contacts or history. JSON parser errors precede controller guards.

200.description: Committed choice; raw business object, Cache-Control no-store.

get.description: Strict query whitelist; duplicate/array/object/unknown keys rejected with 422. Order: guard, query structure/radius/type enum, existing own valid card type, type equality, own participation, capability. No lazy card, query-derived type, latest-result fallback or default INFP. All valid responses are unavailable with count null; never numeric, low_sample or available. No aggregate COUNT query, people, positions, contact values or other-owner identifiers. DB/HTTP failure stays failure. status/reason and errors are new candidate fields/codes requiring review.
